<!-- pr-reviewer: 7c23d749667e26f0ed0bff6266ba11b77ba63cfb -->
**Ready for the maintainer to merge** (delta review of the merge of main at 7c23d7496; last reviewed head f4c9f1ea6). This is a `feat(2d)`: it merges at the next cut. #2037 is stacked on it.

What looks good
- `git show --remerge-diff 7c23d7496` touches three test files only: `crates/app/tests/first_router_part.rs` and `crates/app/tests/level_links/choices.rs` each gain `rest: None` on `OpParams::Pocket`, and `crates/app/tests/level_links.rs` takes main's split. The `roundtrip` helper and `links_round_trip_and_the_defaults_write_no_key` block dropped from `level_links.rs` are the ones that now live in `level_links/choices.rs` on main, with the PR's `rest: None` carried over. Nothing else was dropped or changed.
- Generators, refusals and goldens (`pocket_rest_corners.cl`) are unchanged by the merge. The merge touches no source file.
- The earlier finding is satisfied: the body ends with "Process change: yes", and `.claude/PROCESS_VERSION` is not edited.

Results (locally, trial-merged with current upstream/main, macOS; no GitHub Actions workflow was dispatched)
- camcraft-app `rest_pocket`: 6 passed
- camcraft-motion `rest2d`: 10 passed
- camcraft-app `level_links`: 25 passed (including the moved choices tests)
- camcraft-app `first_router_part`: 4 passed
- camcraft-app `golden_cl`: 33 passed
- camcraft-app `project_roundtrip`: 73 passed
- camcraft-app `operations`: 120 passed, 6 ignored
- camcraft-app lib `rest` filter: 14 passed
- clippy `-p camcraft-app -p camcraft-motion -p camcraft-ui --all-targets -- -D warnings`: clean

Requested before merge
- None.

Notes (not blocking)
- The previous `needs-rework` was set by our own reviewer on the old head; this head answers it.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
